correctness.rationale: The star decomposition gives a 3t constructive upper bound with equality possible only for a fixed hub and perfect leaf pairings; a within-petal pairing admits a 3t-2 route. For each wholly cross-petal pairing, the support of every legal swap factorization must be connected through the hub. The proved transposition-support lemma m >= N+c-2 applied with N=2t+1 and c=t+1 gives 3t. Cyclic pairings a_i with b_(i+1) ensure existence for all t>=2. Inclusion-exclusion counts all antipodes. Exhaustive independent BFS confirms every state and antipodal class through t=4, with finite checks explicitly not used as infinite proof.
